meta.title: Feltora — Handmade Wool Replicas of Your Pet
meta.description: Custom needle-felted pet portraits and miniatures, crafted by hand for pet lovers worldwide.

brand.name: Feltora
brand.tagline: Handmade artistic replicas of your pet

home.heroBody: Custom wool portraits and miniatures made from your pet’s photos — recognizable at a glance.
home.limited: Only a handful of commissions accepted each month.

bond.title: Remembered like family.
bond.body: Every piece begins with the warmth you share with your pet.

craft.title: A familiar face in wool.
craft.body: Needle felting, hand-painted eyes, and sculpted features — made to feel like them.

keep.title: A keepsake you can hold.
keep.body: From photos to finishing, we walk each step with you.

home.processTitle: Bring their personality to life — together
home.processBody: Every Feltora piece is a collaboration: photos, craft, preview, and careful finishing.

photo.title: Photo submission
photo.body: After checkout, share clear photos and a short story of your pet. We’ll help choose the best references.

structure.title: Wool structure
structure.body: We build a sturdy wool base so proportions and expression stay true.

details.title: Eyes, nose & fur
details.body: Hand-painted eyes, sculpted features, and fiber mixed strand by strand for lifelike depth.

preview.title: Preview & review
preview.body: You’ll receive a preview before shipping. Minor adjustments are welcome.

ship.a: Yes. We ship worldwide, with delivery usually taking 2–4 weeks after completion.

time.q: How long does an order take?
time.a: Handmade commissions typically take 3–10 months, depending on the piece. Check each product page for estimates.

made.a: Each piece is needle-felted by hand with natural wool. Noses and mouths are sculpted; full-body figures include a wireframe for poseable paws and tails.

happy.q: How do you ensure I’m happy?
happy.a: We share progress photos and a final preview. We’ll discuss adjustments so the likeness feels right.

portrait.name: Portrait
portrait.description: Framed wool-painted portraits that capture your pet’s expression with museum-level care.

miniature.name: Miniature
miniature.description: Full-body felted figurines — compact keepsakes with remarkable presence.

portraitDog.name: Framed Pet Portrait — Dog
portraitDog.summary: A framed wool portrait that captures your dog’s unmistakable face.
portraitDog.description: Built fiber by fiber from your photos, with hand-finished eyes and features. Ideal for memorials and forever keepsakes.

portraitCat.name: Framed Pet Portrait — Cat
portraitCat.summary: A framed wool portrait tailored to your cat’s gaze and coat pattern.
portraitCat.description: From solid coats to intricate tabbies, we mix wool tones carefully so the likeness feels instantly familiar.

fullBody.name: Full Body Figurine
fullBody.summary: A sculptural miniature of your pet, pose and personality included.
fullBody.description: Needle-felted over a supportive frame. Optional poseable paws let you adjust the stance after delivery.

miniFullBody.name: Mini Full Body Figurine (7–10 cm)
miniFullBody.summary: A smaller full-body keepsake with the same handcrafted detail.
miniFullBody.description: Perfect for desks, shelves, and travel-sized memories — still unmistakably your pet.

guide.title: Photo Guide
guide.intro: Clear photos help us recreate your pet accurately. Share several angles when you can.

tips.light: Use natural daylight; avoid heavy filters.
tips.front: Include a clear front-facing portrait of the face.
tips.side: Add a side profile for ears, muzzle, and posture.
tips.color: Show true coat colors in more than one photo.
tips.story: A short note about personality helps with expression.

about.title: About Feltora
about.body: Feltora is a studio dedicated to handmade wool replicas of beloved pets. We work slowly, commission by commission, so every piece feels personal and true.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about commissions, timing, or photo references? Send us a note.
